description: Local design-source catalog for PE-LCB100 grammar-constrained candidate-manifest provenance. This catalog records retained design anchors; it is not a live literature search log.

sources.title: Project PE-LCB control design
sources.role: Defines PE-LCB100 as a polyethylene chemistry-control companion to the PP-LCB topology grammar under C100 constraints.

sources.title: Long-Chain Branched Polypropylene: Effects of Chain Architecture, Melt Structure, Shear Modification, and Solution Treatment on Melt Relaxation Dynamics
sources.role: Anchors star, comb, H-architecture, and pom-pom long-chain-branched topology classes used by the inherited LCB grammar.
sources.evidence_scope: LCB chain-architecture classes and melt-structure context; used as topology/design grammar context, not as direct PE-LCB property data.

sources.title: Molecular dynamics study of short-chain branching effects on melt behavior of entangled polyethylene: A deep insight of efficacy of branches length, content and distribution
sources.role: Provides polyethylene MD context for branch length, branch content, and branch distribution effects; used to motivate branch-distribution scans within the PE-LCB100 grammar.
sources.evidence_scope: Branch length, content and distribution context for polyethylene melt simulations; used as design-variable context, not as direct PE-LCB property data.

sources.title: Molecular constitutive equations for a class of branched polymers: The pom-pom polymer
sources.role: Provides rheology/topology context for H-like and pom-pom branched architectures.
sources.evidence_scope: Pom-pom branched-polymer architecture and tube-theory context; used as topology grammar context, not as direct MD validation data.

sources.title: Molecular Modulation Mechanisms of Strength-Toughness Performance in Long-Chain Branched Polyethylene
sources.role: Provides long-arm LCB context for pom-pom and long-branch cases retained in the grammar.
sources.evidence_scope: Long-chain-branched polyethylene context; used as long-arm architecture context, not as direct PE-LCB100 target data.

sources.title: Agent-added high-branch topology extension
sources.role: Records b=4/b=5 clustered, gradient, pom-pom, and uniform-comb extensions that fill topology/ML coverage gaps beyond the retained literature anchors.

sources.title: Three-point symmetric branch-placement extension
sources.role: Records a symmetric three-point placement used to improve branch-placement coverage within the frozen grammar.

sources.title: RadonPy automated polymer-MD context
sources.role: Context source for automated all-atom polymer MD and polymer-informatics data products; not used as a direct PE-LCB topology source.

sources.title: SPACIER on-demand polymer-design context
sources.role: Context source for automated MD integrated into polymer design and ML workflows; not used as a direct PE-LCB topology source.

sources.title: HTPMD public data context
sources.role: Context source for high-throughput polymer/electrolyte MD data extraction and rule-profile evidence providers.

sources.title: PoLyInfo public polymer-property context
sources.role: Context source for polymer-property evidence when official exports or local caches are available; not scraped in this workflow.

sources.title: OPLS-AA hydrocarbon benchmark context
sources.role: Context source for force-field and hydrocarbon-density interpretation; not a topology source for the manifest.
